capabilities: render the vault graph as a black hole visualization
assign each top-level folder its own orbit in the accretion disc
open a note by clicking its star
focus the camera on a folder's orbit
switch between eight visual looks and toggle effects from the toolbar
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Installation instructions cover both manual file placement and the community plugin browser.
intentEvidence: Turns your Obsidian graph view into a black hole.
problem: Obsidian's graph view is a plain node-link diagram; this restyles the same data as a themed black-hole visualization where linked notes are pulled visually closer.
summary: Graph view replacement that renders the vault as a black hole, with notes as stars orbiting in discs organized by top-level folder.
